messages.text: BL-1648 🎵 in progress — BL-1428's acceptance scenario 01 asserts a wall-clock age: its handler expects oldest_age_days 35 for a fixture row first seen 2026-08-01 while standing_red_register_cli.bb reads LocalDate/now, so the scenario has been red since 2026-09-06 (49 on 2026-09-19) and surfaced only when BL-1646's changed-path lane ran it - the CLI takes an injected date and the handler pins it
